user.title: Sign in to Kubu
user.description: Reads your hub-connected Kubu door and window sensors from the Kubu cloud. Your login is stored in Home Assistant so it can sign in again when its session expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Kubu again
reauth_confirm.description: Kubu refused the saved login. Enter it again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Kubu cloud. Try again shortly.
error.no_homes: Signed in, but this account has no Kubu homes.
error.wrong_account: That login doesn't have access to this home.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Kubu home is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the Kubu cloud for sensor states. Minimum 30.
